Title: Predictive Test Selection
Main Result: Introduced ML-based PTS using file-path and historical failure features to achieve high recall in CI.
Relationship to E11: Foundational ML PTS paper, but evaluates in aggregate without stratifying false negatives by AST-level structural refactorings.

Title: Towards refactoring-aware regression test selection
Authors: Wang et al. / Silva et al.
Main Result: Demonstrated that deterministic, static/dependency-based RTS tools lose precision or safety under refactoring, and proposed refactoring-aware static mapping.
Relationship to E11: Focuses exclusively on static/deterministic RTS (Dependency Graphs), entirely ignoring Machine Learning (PTS) and feature distribution shift.

Title: BrowserStack / Launchable Industry Reports
Main Result: Industry practitioners acknowledge that ML test selection suffers from 'model drift' caused by deep refactorings and code churn, necessitating manual heuristics or retraining.
Relationship to E11: Provides industry validation of the hypothesis, but lacks peer-reviewed empirical quantification of False Negative Rates stratified by refactoring types.
